name: print-social-checker-halftone-folder-banner-campaigns
title: Blue checker-pattern banner with a 'campaigns key visuals' folder
whatItIs: A wide banner with a fine blue and white checkerboard texture instead of dots, a manila folder labelled 'campaigns key visuals', a blue scribble at the left edge, a pixel cursor and four tool icons.
whatItMeans: Digital and crisp; the checker pattern reads like a screen grid or pixel mesh.
techniques: Swap halftone dots for a fine checkerboard to change the texture but keep the system.
Keep the folder and cursor composition identical.
Put a dark blue swoosh across the pattern for depth.
Use a scribble as a sticker-like accent.

vocabulary.definition: A fine pattern of alternating squares.
Changing one element while keeping the rest.
A category label on a folder.
A grid of pixels as decoration.
